name: generate-skill
description: Use when creating or extending library skill batches, updating guidance after library source or docs change, configuring repository skill distribution, or acting on an Intent review report, including when the maintainer asks only for the library change. For full-library discovery or taxonomy design, use domain-discovery; for generating an approved full-library tree, use tree-generator.
